text: Electrical fire in a server room on the 5th floor, 808 Travis St, Houston. Smoke visible from the street.

ON FLOOR: Houston Symphony (ste 500, 2103 sqft), headcount not known

texts.text: Fire dept: electrical fire, server room floor 5, smoke showing, 808 Travis. Meet crew at main entrance with engineer + keys. Have sprinkler type and server room power shutoff info.

tenant_flags.risk: High occupancy above the fire floor: about 349 people
tenant_flags.why: Building data puts about 349 people on floors 6-27, all above the floor 5 fire. Smoke is already visible from the street, and the building is a 1941 masonry high-rise, so smoke may spread upward through stairs, shafts and voids. Plan for vertical evacuation or shelter-in-place, stairwell pressurization and control, and searches above the fire. Individual tenants and any vulnerable people up there are unknown.

tenant_flags.risk: Fire-floor tenant with unknown occupants (Suite 500, 2,103 sq ft)
tenant_flags.why: This is the only listed tenant on the fire floor. Headcount is not given and the industry is Unknown, so check that Suite 500 is clear during the primary search. The name suggests administrative offices, possibly with visitors and stored instruments or archives. That guess comes only from the name; no hazardous materials or vulnerable occupants are documented.
